rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand with the following token
locative plural indicating the domain of the count
compound denoting wombs or generative devices as the locus

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: These womb-mechanisms constitute a domain of existence.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings located in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms undergo torment.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implicit and supplied from context.
The precise sense of yoniyantra as womb, diagram, or mechanism is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
